extracted.name: Mango, Peach, and Pineapple Salsa
extracted.description: This fruity peach mango salsa with pineapple, bell peppers, tomatoes, and jalapeño adds just the right amount of sweet and spicy to any main dish.
ingredient_lines: 2 small peaches, halved, pitted, and cut into 1/2-inch dice
1 cup chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste
2 tablespoons white sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: Place mangos, peaches, tomatoes, onion, red pepper, yellow pepper, pineapple, and cilantro in a large bowl. Stir in water, sugar, lime juice, jalapeño, garlic, and salt until well combined.
For best flavor, cover and refrigerate until chilled before serving.
